_comment: Historical-mean / persistence / nnls baselines on the local holdout (fit <= 2031-01-31, eval = 2031-02). Used as the zero point for every delta reported by evaluate.py. Regenerate with calibrate_t1.py, score_task2.py and calibrate_t3.py. Read as relative, not absolute: the holdout month is easier than validation.
_e_lwr_note: S_LWR is pinned at 0 whenever E_LWR > 1, so the panel is blind to small improvements. Track E_LWR instead - lower is better, and it moves continuously.
